column1: # gerlach1252 key: Julius Kohn's key of 1889 (Wellcome MS.309 pp.260-261, scans 0265-0266) as set up by the contributor (key_v3), issue #439.

# The leaves carry rows of sign groups only, no letters; letter values come from the order of the groups (Z to A) and were re-aligned by the contributor where the text required (u, t, s groups are one step out of line, he says).

column3: fe-like ligature (tall f + e); nearly always followed by C = "ch"
d-like: vertical stem with small triangle/loop on the left (reversed q)
small o with tail up to the right (sigma-like)
> angle sign (Kohn sheet only, not yet seen in text)
small o joined by a bar to a 7-like hook ("arrow"); Kohn's g group "arrow, 2e"
OPEN figure 4: left vertical + bar + right stem, top not closed (like a "ч" with bar)
small o with cross-arm to the right (o+)
H-like, two posts with bar (often slanted)
reversed 3 / E with a middle bar, before u in "quecksilber" (p.115 heading) (probable)
CLOSED figure 4 with the stem through the middle, bottom ending in a point (kite / triangle on a cross)
m/pi-like sign with a cross on top
CLOSED figure 4 of modern form: triangle to the left, stem on the right, flat foot (no point)
circle with long vertical stroke (with or without a short crossbar)
4 with loop at top (like Greek koppa) (Kohn sheet only, not yet seen in text)
script capital L (Kohn sheet only, not yet seen in text)
Roman II / pi without overhang (Kohn sheet only, not yet seen in text)
upward arrow (Kohn sheet only, not yet seen in text)
reversed-J hook with crossbar (Kohn sheet only, not yet seen in text)
cross with bar on top (after TRI = tz)
